game.title: Dragon's Dogma 2
game.blurb: Open-world fantasy action RPG from Capcom, released 2024-03-21. RAWG average playtime: 22 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: From escaping your chains to reaching Vernworth, crossing the border and taking the throne.

chapters.title: The Unmoored World and the True Ending
chapters.summary: The late-game turn, Norgan and the end of the cycle. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Vocations and Pawns
chapters.summary: Every vocation, maister teachings and training your pawn.

chapters.title: Exploration and Travel
chapters.summary: Dungeons, landmarks, oxcarts, Ferrystones, griffins and Seeker's Tokens.

chapters.title: Monster Feats
chapters.summary: Special ways to beat giants, medusas, the headless horseman and more.

chapters.title: People and Everyday Life
chapters.summary: Affinity, housing, camping, cooking, hot springs and bringing people back.

notes: Backlog game, added from the docs/PLAN.md candidate list. No StrategyWiki page under this title. dragonsdogma.fandom.com answers the API under "Dragon's Dogma II", with about 26 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 7 of 60 Steam achievements are hidden. Most are visible and tell the story beats, so the chapters follow them.
